cover_title: Turn One Idea Into Ten Posts
cover_subtitle: Quick system to automate weekly social content

slides.title: Define the Output Shape
slides.body: → State “short paragraphs, 1‑2 sentences each, mobile‑first.” → Mention bold limits and line breaks. The model follows this layout automatically.

slides.title: Feed the Core Idea
slides.body: → Provide the article title or key point. → Keep it under 10 words. The AI expands this into multiple posts while keeping the shape you defined.

slides.title: Add Tone Instructions
slides.body: → Write “direct, honest, no hedging.” → Include “use RM, mention KL if relevant.” The model mimics your voice.

slides.title: Generate Multiple Variations
slides.body: → Ask for “5 versions for LinkedIn, 3 for Twitter, 2 for Instagram.” → Each respects the same format rules.

slides.title: Review & Schedule
slides.body: → Scan for any missed numbers or tone slips. → Load into your scheduler; you have a week’s content in minutes.

last_slide: Follow for weekly AI‑automation tips from Malaysia.
